notes.title: Trading Cards & Points Shop Are Live for Lust Academy Final!
notes.content:
[b]Great news, mages![/b]
We’re thrilled to announce that Steam Trading Cards are now available for Lust Academy Final!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859716/7a950cf0d65808b2a1c82df220703326a876f910.png[/img]
Collect beautifully illustrated cards featuring your favorite characters, craft badges, and unlock stunning profile backgrounds to show off your magical style.

[b]What’s Included:[/b]
[list]
[*] Trading Cards 
[*] Steam Badge 
[*] Emoticons 
[*] Profile Backgrounds 
[*] Mini Profile Backgrounds 
[*] Animated Profile Backgrounds
[*] Avatar Profile Frame
[*] Animated Avatars.
[/list]
Whether you're a collector or want to add some Lust Academy charm to your Steam experience, now’s the perfect time to jump back in 💜

notes.title: Lust Academy Final is OUT NOW + 2 DLCs + Special Bundles!
notes.content:

We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Lust Academy Final is now available![/b]

[list]
[*] A fiery new adventure with deepened relationships and intense choices

notes.title: Weekly DevBlog Update
notes.content:
[i]As always, we can't miss an opportunity to tell you guys another dad joke we have:
What did the wizard say at the frat party?
...
Abracada bro![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859716/22aebbded8d9df84bf8ab95039ffe8eaa484bfa2.png[/img]
And if you're wondering how Season 4 of Lust Academy is developing, we've prepared a handy list. Here, take a look:
 •  Finished [b]two scenes [/b]for Intro of season 4 of Lust Academy.

That's all for today, folks! Stay tuned for more exciting news about the new season of Lust Academy!

[i]Sincerely, 
Bear in the Night team.[/i]

notes.title: Weekly DevBlog Update
notes.content:
[b]Hey there! This is our weekly DevUpdate.[/b]

[i]As always, we can't miss an opportunity to tell you guys another dad joke we have:
What font does the mermaid use when typing?
...
Ariel! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859716/e7bcd7f41c6563fc9d205c4fdc33dc22c0479df7.png[/img]
Now, when the weekly dosage of laughter is reached, check out the release of [b]Lust Academy Season 3[/b] in Steam:

This is a huge deal for us and we're very thankful for your support. Leave your reviews on the Steam page of the game; we appreciate it very much!

Oh, we've almost forgotten to share what we've done in the previous week. Here, take a look:

[b]That's all for today, folks! Stay tuned for more exciting news about the new season of Lust Academy![/b]

[i]Sincerely, 
Bear in the Night team.[/i]
